phytase.name: Phytase / Acid Rest
phytase.purpose: Lowers mash pH naturally (rarely used today; replaced by modern brewing acids).

ferulic.name: Ferulic Acid Rest
ferulic.purpose: Releases ferulic acid to create the clove-like aroma in German Hefeweizens.

beta_glucan.name: Beta-Glucan Rest
beta_glucan.purpose: Breaks down gums in sticky, high-viscosity grains like oats, rye, and unmalted wheat.

protein.name: Protein Rest
protein.purpose: Breaks down complex proteins to improve yeast health and reduce chill haze in under-modified malts.

beta_amylase.name: Beta-Amylase Rest
beta_amylase.purpose: Creates highly fermentable sugars (maltose) for a dry, clean-finishing beer with high alcohol conversion.

alpha_amylase.name: Alpha-Amylase Rest
alpha_amylase.purpose: Breaks down remaining starches into unfermentable dextrins, adding body and reducing fermentability.

beta_alpha_amylase.name: Beta/Alpha-Amylase Rest
beta_alpha_amylase.purpose: Simultaneous beta- and alpha-amylase activity for balanced everyday brewing. Used as the "single infusion" rest.

mash_out.name: Mash-out
mash_out.purpose: Raises the mash to mash-out temperature to halt enzymatic activity and improve lautering.
